cases.screenshotMode: viewport after native PageDown; inspector sampled after controls settled; no full-page resize

viewer.tierPolicy: Real production quality switch; no Three.LOD objects unless actually discovered

authoritative.scope: Actual species point/body/ramp and source visitor graph queries; no mesh substitutes, path edits, clocks or state mutation. Pixel contact and rendered interpolation need separate scene inspection.

limits: Picking checks real current catalog triangles with the unchanged production raycastScene; closer real surfaces and out-of-view samples are explicitly reported, not mislabeled wrong selection.

Macaws, their food/water/perch and visitors have no individual production SceneIdentity contract. Their real root transforms and QA subtree selection are inspected; individual product scene picking is NA, not an invented capability.

Posed actor AABBs are conservative. Frozen/cold roots can be compared exactly to canonical positions; animated roots can lag by a rendered sync interval, so last-tick delta is diagnostic only. No pixel-perfect clipping, sightline or collision guarantee is inferred from boxes.
Zebra absent in V4; its four actors/8x8 fence/path must be rerun under R7 once implemented.

notes: Each screenshot uses a viewport capture after native keyboard page scrolling; canvas fully visible was checked. It does not resize the WebGL viewport.
Inspector JSON is sampled after actions settle; viewer degrees/zoom and cached audit camera zoom must agree.
Zoom1/3 are inspection-camera ratios; this is not a claim that source production camera controls or a physical device were used.

Tile:habitat projects onto the real enclosure-owned floor; source production raycast correctly returns the owning habitat rather than a hidden underlying tile. All other 35 sampled categories confirmed at least once.
